capabilities: Toggle a focus mode that hides distracting interface elements
Choose which elements to hide from the settings tab
Run custom integrations on entering and leaving zen-mode
extras: Supports beta installation via Obsidian42 - BRAT; planned features include command macros for integrations and focus profiles.
intentEvidence: A focus mode Obsidian plugin. Inspired by "iA Writer".
motivation: The author was inspired by iA Writer's approach to removing distractions, letting users disable elements on a whim.
problem: Obsidian shows many interface elements that can distract during focused writing, and they cannot be selectively hidden.

relations.evidence: This plugin works perfectly with my other plugin, Simple Zoom

summary: Focus mode plugin that hides chosen Obsidian interface elements on demand for distraction-free writing.
